correctness.rationale: Uniform-simplex translation gives the exact k-fold threshold conditional second moment; inclusion-exclusion gives the mixed moment; exact harmonic identities and Dirichlet moments give covariance and correlation. Strict positivity follows analytically from \(F_m-F_{m-1}=2(H_m-1)/m>0\). The attached exact-rational checker independently replays the integral algebra and marginal moments on broad finite ranges.

value.rationale: Maximum spacing and Greenwood concentration are canonical complementary diagnostics of a random partition. The theorem gives an exact finite-dimension dependence law, proves its strict sign, and quantifies asymptotic decoupling. The statement is structural across every dimension rather than a finite computation or arbitrary parameter slice.
